research_question: given the same already-supported personalized Human model, does persistent current-model trust allow gamma to recover from conservative pacing and materially improve task efficiency without interaction, motion-envelope, or safety-chain regression

source_artifact.selection: final active model after repetition 5; queued but inactive successor excluded

trust_driven_pacing.gamma_semantics: existing persistent current-model trust, confidence filter, hysteresis, and rate limits
trust_driven_pacing.raw_support_source: exact model-versioned POST_UPDATE POSITIVE provenance from source artifact

decision_rules.causal_gamma_recovery: raw support is restored only from the source artifact evidence for the exact active model; filtered confidence starts at zero; gamma changes only after the existing filter, hysteresis, and rate limits
decision_rules.material_efficiency: trust-driven mean task duration is at least 5 percent lower and at least two of three matched repetitions are shorter
decision_rules.meaningful_interaction_regression: trust-driven arm exceeds fixed arm matched mean peak force, force integral, or peak moment by more than 10 percent
decision_rules.registered_constraint_regression: any new task abort, deployable or evaluation-only motion-envelope violation, NO_SAFE_ACTION, force gate, Safety Filter intervention, BRAKE, or MuJoCo warning
decision_rules.TG-A: causal gamma recovery, material efficiency improvement, and no meaningful interaction or registered-constraint regression
decision_rules.TG-B: causal gamma recovery and acceptable closed loop, but material efficiency rule is not met
decision_rules.TG-C: trust/gamma authority inconsistency or meaningful closed-loop/constraint regression
